title: srMetaSuite v1.3.0 — Enhanced Video Bulk Publisher & Smart Session Engine
changelog:
### What's New in v1.3.0:
- 🚀 High-Speed Bulk Reels Publisher: Multi-row Facebook Reels publishing with scoped title/description DOM insertion and dynamic table scrolling.
- 🛡️ Smart Stalled Video Pruner: Auto-detects 0% stalled uploads (30s safety timeout) and prunes stuck items to keep the queue running seamlessly.
- 🌐 DataImpulse Proxy Exhaustion Guard: Instant real-time alerts when bandwidth quota is depleted.
- 🔒 Unified CDP Session Engine: High-reliability session verification and persistent browser launch architecture.
